## MEGA DSC (TEACHER RECRUITMENT TEST) – 2025
CALL LETTER FOR CERTIFICATE VERIFICATION

To
HT No.: MDSC0045829
Name: TIPPAGALLAPUSPANJALI
Address: Aggipettala Factory Street, Near Sangeeta School, Rayachoti( Urban ),
Rayachoti( Urban ), Kadapa-516269
Contact No.: 9346815877
Email: tpushpa.anjali@gmail.com
***

***

It is hereby informed that Sri / Smt. / Kumari TIPPAGALLAPUSPANJALI, S/o /
D/o / W/o Sri TIPPAGALLAVENKATA RAMANA, appeared for Mega DSC – 2025, is
hereby requested to attend for Certificate Verification in person as per the schedule given
below.

Date of certificate verification: 07-Sept-2025

Venue: kdp_committee_14, SV COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING,
BALAJI NAGAR, KADAPA

Time:                                9.00 AM

Before attending for certificate verification, please upload all relevant
certificates/documents at candidate login (apdsc.apcfss.in).

Further, it is informed that issuance of a call letter for certificate verification
does not confer any right to selection. Attendance at certificate verification is solely for the
purpose of confirming the particulars furnished in the online application. The final selection
of candidates will be subject to merit, eligibility, reservation, and other prescribed
conditions.

If the candidate fails to attend certificate verification, or fails to produce the
required certificates at the time of verification, or if the certificates are found to be non-
genuine or incorrect, **such candidates shall forfeit the right of selection, and the next**
**eligible candidate will be considered for certificate verification.**

List of Original Documents to be Produced:

1. Printout of the Online Application of Mega DSC–2025.
2. SSC or its equivalent certificate.
3. Intermediate or its equivalent certificate.
4. Academic qualification certificates (Degree Or Post-Graduation).
5. Professional qualification certificates (D.Ed./Spl.D.Ed/ B.Ed/Spl.B.Ed / UGDPE /
6. B.P.Ed., etc.).
7. TET/CTET Original Score Card/Marks memo
8. Study Certificates from Class IV to X (seven years) must be submitted. Or
9. Residence certificate for 07 years prior to appearing in SSC, if appeared for S.S.C. as

9/6/25, 8:21 PM                                                              CallLetter

a Private Candidate. Candidates who migrated from Telangana to Andhra Pradesh
between 2nd June, 2014 and 1st June, 2024 as per G.O. Ms. No. 161, General
Administration (SPF&MC) Department, dated.27.12.2022 and as per terms laid
down in Circular Memo No.4136/SPF & MC/2015-5, Dated.20.11.2017 and Circular
Memo No.4136/SPF & MC/2015-17, Dated.27.12.2022 of Government of Andhra
Pradesh shall obtain the Local Status Certificate from competent authority and produce
at the time of verification

8. The rule of reservation to local candidates is applicable as per the provisions of Andhra
Pradesh Public Employment (OLC & RDR) Order (Presidential Order)1975, and
amendments thereon shall be followed strictly.

9. Integrated Community Certificate issued by the Tashildhar (for candidates who have
claimed reservation under BC-A,B,C,D & E/SC(Group-I, II & III)/ST categories).

10. EWS Certificate issued by the Tashildhar who claimed reservation under EWS
Reservation.

11. PH Certificate issued by the Referral Hospital (if applicable).

12. RCI registration Certificate (if applicable).

13. Service Certificate issued by Competent Authorities of the Department of Defense,
GOI if applied under Ex-servicemen Quota.

14. Experience Certificate (for the post of Principal, if applicable) as per the norms issued
in the notification

## Important Information and Instructions:

1. Horizontal reservations (for Women, PBD, Meritorious Sports Persons, Ex-
2. Servicemen) will be implemented as per rules in force and relevant Government
3. Orders.
4. The purpose of this letter is solely to verify the particulars furnished in the online
5. application, which is a pre-requisite for consideration of candidature. Selection will be
6. subject to fulfillment of all prescribed conditions.
7. Candidates must produce all requisite original certificates on the date at the time of
8. verification without fail. Failure to attend or produce certificates will result in
9. cancellation of candidature for selection.
10. Candidates must upload the certificates in his/her MEGA DSC-2025 login before
11. attending the certificate verification venue.
12. Candidates must bring all original certificates/documents which are uploaded in the
13. online application along with three sets of xerox copies of the certificates/documents
14. duly attested by a Gazetted Officer.
15. Candidates should bring five recent passport-size photographs identical to the one
16. uploaded in the online application.

Note: The mere call letter is only for certificate verification and does not confer
any right of selection.

Convenor, MEGA DSC-2025
